description: This file contains shell functions related to the upgrade process for specific hardware boards in the OpenWRT project, including checking image metadata, performing upgrades, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Checks the board name and sets a requirement for image metadata if the board matches specific patterns.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines if the upgrade is supported on the current board based on its name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing the image to the appropriate disk device on supported boards.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the appropriate partition on supported boards.
